preflight_verdict_meaning: Bounded 01B-3 is feasible if and only if the transition API stops replacing authority with caller-supplied full next_state. 01B-2 remains historically accepted and MD-015-ineligible. Naive token-clone onto current API is blocking correctness conflict.

recommended_design.summary: Keep snapshot-log authority. Replace write API with scoped command applied to current replayed snapshot; append resulting full snapshot under next global sequence.
preserve: global committed_sequence as physical order only
require: explicit command type with write-set tokens
CAS only write-set tokens not global sequence for semantic validity
apply onto current replayed state then finalize_derived_fields
reject stale full-state proposals that would rewind unrelated authority
disqualified: sqlite precondition struct clone including expected_generation

full_state_overwrite_risk.required_invariant: unrelated authority change plus stale full-state proposal cannot overwrite or rewind unrelated authority

recommended_owner_gate_question: Authorize follow-on 01B-3 implementation WP with scoped-command apply onto current replayed snapshot (option 1), or declare APPEND_SELECTION_INELIGIBLE_UNDER_MD_015 if that API change is refused?
stop_conditions: 01B-3 claims MD-015 from 91e258c or C4-only stale tests
